about: The kit's license policy (SEC-005, ADR-0004, ADR-0079), read by Test-PackageLicenses.ps1. 'licenses' are SPDX ids free for commercial use; 'packages' allow one package under one license each, pinned, with the reason. A repo adds its own, or sets "commercial": true, in .config/package-licenses.json.
